burn.title: Jalan ke liye prathamik upchar
bullet_points: Jale hue hisse ko thande paani se dhoyen.
Vahan par koi cream ya tel na lagayen.
Agar jaldi theek na ho, to doctor se milen.

cut.title: Chot ya katne par prathamik upchar
bullet_points: Chot ko paani se saaf karein.
Rakt-srav rokne ke liye halka dabav dalen.
Anti-septic cream lagayen aur bandage bandhen.
Agar gehri chot ho to turant hospital jayen.

snakebite.title: Saamp ke katne par prathamik upchar
bullet_points: Kante hue ang ko jyaada hilaen nahi.
Kante hue jagah ko paani se dhoyen.
Turant 108 par call karke madad mangein.

fever.title: Bukhaar ke liye prathamik upchar
bullet_points: Bahut saara paani aur taral padarth piyen.
Bheega hua kapda mathe par rakhen.
Agar bukhaar badh jaaye to doctor se salah lein.
